## df53944d9b47

**Reproduced defect — canonical guide-line support is absent.** Every official input uses a full vertical color-7 guide: 9, 10, and 10 cells in one column. The generator instead requires exactly one color-7 marker. Its `self_check` rejects all three canonical inputs, while 300/300 sampled default draws across easy/medium/hard contain exactly one color-7 cell.

The official self-check reproducer fails with messages such as `expected exactly one color-7 axis marker, found 9`; see `checks/audit-df53944d9b47-selfcheck/result.json`. The source-bound census is `checks/audit-df53944d9b47-census.json`, and a canonical train[0] counterexample with selected Racket output, rule hash, validator result, and command metadata is retained at `checks/audit-df53944d9b47-counterexample.json`.

This is both a validator defect and a distribution gap. Training examples can teach “mirror around an isolated marker” rather than recognition of the canonical guide line. I also checked the selected Racket rule on the counterexample; the rule executes correctly, so the finding is confined to the generator/validator. **Patch status: audit only; unchanged.**
